verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an LLM-oriented documentation index. Agent-oriented docs access is also documented: the MCP server lets AI assistants read Sentry documentation, and a one-command install teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok to set up Sentry. Missing for 10: no evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g., a full-content variant), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.sentry.io/llms.txt # Sentry Documentation
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
